title: Protect the Ball Under Pressure
description: A ball handler keeps the dribble alive while a defender applies close, legal pressure, learning to shield the ball with the body and the off-arm.

content.objective: Keep the ball alive and protected under close defensive pressure.
content.setup: A ball handler faces a defender applying close pressure in a confined space.
instructions: Dribble while keeping the body between the ball and the defender's chair.
Use the off-arm to shield rather than push the defender away.
Change hands and change the dribble's rhythm to keep the defender guessing.
Rotate roles after 30 seconds so both players get both jobs.
coachingPoints: Keep the ball on the side furthest from the defender at all times.
Stay low and balanced in the chair rather than leaning away.
Use quick hand and rhythm changes rather than just speed.
commonMistakes: Picking up the dribble out of panic under pressure.
Pushing off the defender's chair illegally instead of shielding with the body.
Speeding up until control breaks down, instead of building speed gradually.
content.safety: Defenders apply close pressure without initiating chair-to-chair contact beyond what's legal.
